scientific_question: Does the faithful fitted JH01 RV24 persistence model provide materially better outcome-unseen 24-hour realized-volatility forecasts than literal naive persistence, with fixed simple benchmarks reported without rescue authority?

frozen_target.return_construction: r_i,h = log(C_i,h / C_i,h-1), at hourly close boundary h; r_m,h is the equal-weighted mean across the exact ordered 20-symbol panel.
frozen_target.safe_known_after: Every feature return has bar_close_time <= t; the target's first return begins after t.

candidate.information_set: RV24_prior,t and only historical target/feature pairs known before t

B0.formula: expanding-history mean of prior realized RV24_future values

B2.formula: same intercept-and-slope one-lag RV24 regression as C_JH01
B2.reason: Identical information set, target, functional form, and fitted parameters; excluded from comparisons.

model_set.model_equivalence_verdict: C_JH01 is distinct from B0, B1, and B3, but mathematically identical to B2.

prospective_holdout.evaluation_start_rule: The fixed first listed origin; no skipped, substituted, or later start is permitted.
prospective_holdout.evaluation_end_rule: The fixed last listed origin after exactly 365 valid daily origins; any missing origin blocks evaluation.

point_in_time_controls: feature bars close no later than t
training targets end strictly before t
forecast is persisted before target availability

loss_and_testing.nested_model_handling: C_JH01 is the fitted flexible extension of fixed B1, so the primary test uses the preregistered Clark-West-style adjusted MSPE differential. B3 nests C_JH01 and is reported descriptively only; no invalid unadjusted nested-model p-value will be used as a rescue.
loss_and_testing.serial_correlation_handling: Daily targets do not overlap, but loss differentials may remain dependent; HAC is therefore mandatory.

materiality_gate.rationale: A fixed decision threshold to exclude trivially small improvements; it is a governance threshold, not a universal economic constant.

classification.INCREMENTAL_FORECAST_VALUE_SUPPORTED_WIT: C_JH01 has lower primary MSE, relative reduction >= 0.05, and one-sided adjusted-MSPE HAC p <= 0.05.
classification.NO_INCREMENTAL_FORECAST_VALUE_FOUND: A valid evaluation fails any primary direction, 5% materiality, or statistical-evidence gate.
classification.INCONCLUSIVE: A valid evaluation cannot be classified by the frozen primary gates because the prespecified test is computationally indeterminate without an integrity failure.
classification.BLOCKED: A source, data, timing, point-in-time, or contract integrity gate fails before a valid evaluation.
classification.primary_kill_condition: Failure to materially improve outcome-unseen primary performance versus B1 retains prior persistence evidence but ends this JH01 representation as an incremental forecasting primitive; no rescue analysis may reverse it.

models_removed: B2 one-lag AR: redundant with C_JH01
search_accounting.multiplicity_policy: One primary comparison and one primary loss. B0/B3 and MAE are secondary descriptive reports only and cannot rescue failure; no model sweep, horizon sweep, subgroup, asset, transform, or baseline substitution is allowed.
